resources.string:
1️⃣ Tic Tac Toe is a 2-player game.
 2️⃣ The board has 9 squares (3x3 grid).
 3️⃣ Player 1 uses X and Player 2 uses O.
 4️⃣ Players take turns marking empty squares.
 5️⃣ The first player to get 3 of their marks in a row (horizontally, vertically, or diagonally) wins.
 6️⃣ If all 9 squares are filled and no one wins, the game is a draw!
